title: A durable original checkpoint that Engram keeps answering with the same uncertified error is bounded only by 65,536 attempts (~455 days); it needs a typed terminal unresolved hold after a practical cap, without dropping the report
outcome: An original closing checkpoint whose exact replay keeps getting the same uncertified Engram error reaches, after a practical cap, a typed terminal unresolved hold that is visible to the operator. The report and the original request stay in custody and are never dropped silently.
acceptance: A durable original checkpoint that Engram keeps answering with the same uncertified error is bounded only by 65,536 attempts (~455 days); it needs a typed terminal unresolved hold after a practical cap, without dropping the report is done
